summary_en: Trailhead Global declared an interim dividend of 1.00 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 2027, with a record date of September 30, 2026 and payment date of November 30, 2026. This marks the company's first dividend distribution in 10 fiscal periods since March 2017, following the elimination of accumulated deficit through capital reserve reduction on July 31, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Payment (Interim Dividend and Dividend Resumption)
translation_en_brief:
Trailhead Global Holdings announced an interim dividend of 1.00 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026, payable on November 30, 2026. The total dividend payment is 37 million yen. This marks the company's first dividend distribution in 10 fiscal periods since the fiscal year ended March 2017.

The company implemented this dividend following the elimination of accumulated deficit through a capital reserve reduction and surplus disposition executed on July 31, 2026. These measures restored the company's financial position to enable dividend payments. The interim dividend aligns with the dividend forecast announced on May 15, 2026.

Under its medium-term management plan for 2030-2031, the company targets an annual dividend of 10.00 yen per share by fiscal year ended March 2031. Management stated that the policy is to gradually increase dividend levels in line with profit growth, using this dividend resumption as a starting point while continuing growth investments and strengthening financial foundations. For the full fiscal year, the company projects a dividend of 3.00 yen per share, with an expected year-end dividend of 2.00 yen per share.
